strategy_roster.name: Double Vegas SuperTrend Enhanced
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(close, ema(close,10) + 3 * atr(high,low,close,10)) and crossabove(close, ema(close,20) + 3 * atr(high,low,close,20))
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < ema(close,10) + 3 * atr(high,low,close,10) or close < ema(close,20) + 3 * atr(high,low,close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: Each SuperTrend is approximated by its trend line (EMA basis + multiplier x ATR) and the long signal requires both lines bullish, with either bearish flip exiting. ATR periods 10/20, multiplier 3 and the EMA basis are explicit fallbacks; Vegas-channel volatility adaptation, hold-days and the parameterless take-profit/stop-loss inputs are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Falcon Liquidity Grab
strategy_roster.notes: The documented long rule is a low below the swing-period extreme with a close back above the SMA, so a 10-bar prior-bar low plus SMA(50) is an explicit fallback for the unnamed swing period and SMA length. The mirrored bearish grab supplies the long exit; the session filter, 15-minute timeframe and tick-based stop/target have no documented numbers.

strategy_roster.name: XAUUSD Trend
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,9), ema(close,21)) and rsi(close,14) < 30 and close > bb_upper(close,20,2)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented long combines a fast-EMA up-cross, oversold RSI and a close above the upper band; EMA 9/21, RSI 14/30 and Bollinger 20/2 are explicit fallbacks because no values are given. A down-cross or overbought RSI is the long exit proxy since the risk-percentage stop and take-profit:stop ratio produce no fixed percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Slope RSI MTF
strategy_roster.notes: Hull slopes across 5m/1h/4h/1d cannot be resampled in this single-series DSL, so the documented SlopeTriggerLength 60 and SlopeTrendLength 200 become EMA(60)/EMA(200) alignment and the entry is the up-cross; the long RSI tier is relaxed to the documented 50 mid level because the strict 90 tier never co-occurs with a cross. ATR(21) stop/target offsets, MaxOrders scaling and compounding sizing are not percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Flash Strategy Minervini Qualifier
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,12) > close * 1.01 and close > ema(close,10) + 3 * atr(high,low,close,10) and rsi(close,10) > 60
strategy_roster.exit_long: ema(close,12) < close * 0.99 or close < ema(close,10) - 3 * atr(high,low,close,10)
strategy_roster.notes: Documented defaults are used: EMA(12) with EmaPercent 0.01 read as a trailing line 1% from price, SuperTrend approximated by EMA(10)+3xATR(10), momentum RSI(10)>60. Exits are the opposite trailing line or SuperTrend flip; the Minervini stage filter, intraday timeframe and neural/divergence options are unavailable and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: WPRSI Signal
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R is rewritten as range position, so WPR above -20 (top 20% of the 14-bar range) plus RSI(14) above the mid level gives the long signal and the -80 mirror gives the exit. Period 14, the -20/-80 bands and FilterUp/FilterDown bar counts are explicit fallbacks; the confirmation-window counting and CandleType selection are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Nevalyashka Flip
strategy_roster.notes: The expert always alternates sell/buy with no market-derived signal, so the impossible negative-price guard blocks fabricating an entry. The 50/50 pip protective orders, lot multiplier and order-book quote handling are pip/volume concepts, not fixed percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Return
strategy_roster.notes: The paired buy-limit grid around the StartHour price is replaced by the buy-limit half: price dipping under a 20-bar mean and closing back above it, with the exit at a 9-bar mean as the net-profit flush proxy. DistancePips/StepPips grid spacing, trailing-stop ratchets, EndHour and Friday flattening are schedule and pip features the DSL cannot express.

strategy_roster.name: Volume EA
strategy_roster.notes: The new-hour volume spike is expressed as one-bar volume growth above a Factor of 1.5 (roc>50%), and CCI confirmation is approximated by a 20-bar z-score above zero; both are explicit fallbacks since no values are documented. The hourly open timing, short-side CCI bands and trailing stop in price steps are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Volume per Point
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(volume,1) > 0 and atr(high,low,close,14) < sma(atr(high,low,close,14),20) and rsi(close,14) > 50
strategy_roster.notes: Bar-to-bar range change is not available, so a contracting ATR(14) versus its SMA(20) proxies the shrinking-range premise while rising volume and RSI(14)>50 supply the long filter; exit is expanding range or contracting volume. RSI length 14 and the 50 threshold are explicit fallbacks and CandleType selection is unsupported.
